comment: B1072 Option F validation smoke launch evidence. Council 186 Option-4 SEPARATE-RECONFIRM. 22-month NVDA window crossing sim_day=200 boundary to empirically validate Option F triple-gated A1-PROMOTION fix before B1073 Phase D R5 relaunch.

monitoring_armament.layer_3_claude_monitor_polling: ARMED THIS TURN (5-min cadence; 60-min cap per smoke wall-clock; SMOKE_COMPLETE OR SMOKE_FAIL OR B1019_HALT terminal grep; per CHECKLIST #117 armed AT smoke-completion event boundary)

B1071 HALT was at Phase 2 (10 tickers) which is also < 1000 floor; B1072 Option F should fix both cases
if smoke HALTs at sim_day=200 boundary -> Option F gate logic wrong -> HALT for owner direction (NOT B1073 launch)
